Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties. This was an upfront-quoted trip: EV-FARE-02814 carries fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE and quoted_fare_sgd 21.50. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02814) measures 19.71 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off events against a booked optimal route of 14.6 km on EV-TRIP-02814 — an excess of 5.11 km, or 35.00% of optimal. That passes both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so the route deviation the rider complains of is established on this trip's own trace. It is NOT a MATERIAL deviation: 35.00% is below the 50% mark and 5.11 km is below the 8.0 km mark, so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged in any event; and had it been, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 0 against 396 completed trips_90d establishes no repeat pattern, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the conduct referral is available. Because the fare was fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however much longer the driven route was than the quote. The rider's remedy is POL-RD-11(a): charged_total SGD 31.80 less quoted_fare SGD 21.50 less the properly chargeable pass-through and statutory lines, which total SGD 0.00 here (no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, waiting_time_fee 0.00) = SGD 10.30, already a multiple of 0.05. The rider contested SGD 14.00; the policy measures an upfront-quote remedy as the excess over the quote, so SGD 10.30 is the sum and the balance is not payable — the rider's own advocate did not contend for it. The driver's answer, 'The meter adds the extra distance', names no evidence ID and no clause, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight and is discarded; it also misdescribes an upfront-quote fare, whose distance and time lines were fixed at booking. No rider-requested detour can be invoked (EV-CHAT-02814 holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot run), no endpoint was amended (amended_optimal_distance_km, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run), and this is not a pooled trip (vehicle_type RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not re-base the comparison). The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02814-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and is cited only for its own absence: it carries no fact, no external traffic cause was asserted against it by any party, and it therefore triggers no escalation under POL-RD-10(5). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (155 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) do not engage and no independent corroboration is required. Confidence is 0.90, capped at 1.0 by the deciding artifacts (EV-FARE-02814, EV-GPS-02814, EV-TRIP-02814), all at weight 1.0. One procedural note: the monetary effect of SGD 10.30 exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling issues but the amount is held for release by a human reviewer rather than executed automatically. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 10.30 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It exceeds the threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed: it is held for release and the case is placed in the human queue.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.
